chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

There are ten places where salat (prayer) is not performed: mud, water, the bathhouse, graves, the beaten parts of the road, ant colonies, camel resting places, the watercourse, saline land, and snow.
ai.seo_question: What places are not permissible for performing salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام lists ten places in which salat (prayer) should not be performed. It is a jurisprudential text concerning the proper location of prayer and the conditions affecting its validity or permissibility.
